source_records.title: The two conjugations and real Frobenius
source_records.as_he_states: He states that the Betti conjugation σ and the real de Rham descent conjugation τ commute, with τσ=στ=f_R, and that f_R interchanges the Hodge filtrations.
source_records.plausible_today: For a real smooth projective variety and its rational Betti realization, f_R is the linear involution induced by geometric complex conjugation.
